theorems.name: Submission.rpn_pfd_extDeriv_sum_smul_wedge
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (g : ι → Eucl P → ℝ) (β : ι → Fin m → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (x : Eucl P), (∀ j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (g j) x) → extDeriv (fun z => ∑ j : ι, g j z • wedgeCovectors m (β j)) x = ∑ j : ι, wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (Fin.cons (fderiv ℝ (g j) x) (β j) : Fin (m + 1) → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ))
